objective: Propose a small-scope scenario direction for a 2D prototype without changing approved canon.
director_intent: Keep the player-facing story lightweight and tied to gameplay motivation. Do not lock canon without approval.
approved_scope: Identify approval items for canon-sensitive choices.
Recommend follow-up WorkOrders if more design work is needed.
non_goals: Do not change source, data, assets, or workflow state.
stop_conditions: Stop if canon status is unclear and the answer would require canon claims.
Stop if implementation work is requested.
Stop if source, data, asset, commit, or push permission is needed.
